description: This file defines SCSS mixins for rotated and flipped icons, specific to the Font Awesome icon library. It contains styles for rotating icons by 90, 180, and 270 degrees, as well as flipping icons horizontally and vertically. Additionally, it includes styles to nullify filters for older IE versions.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Mixin to apply rotation transformations to icons.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Mixin to apply flip transformations to icons.
